title: RitualCore Altar: Progression
summary: Move from calibration into relic, curse, spell, and rift rituals in stable steps.

blocks.title: Calibration
blocks.body: Start with Aether Calibration so the player learns structure, catalyst, output, and feedback with low risk.

blocks.title: Specialization
blocks.body: Then move into Relic Stabilization, Curse Cleansing I, Spell Core Awakening, and Rift Crack Reveal as the related addons appear.

blocks.title: Future Depth
blocks.body: Timed rituals, moon timing, weather effects, rendered pedestal items, and deeper sacrifices should arrive after the safe altar loop is dependable.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
